prompts.question: Is the accounting firm or its nominated tax practitioner officially registered on the Tax Practitioners Board (TPB) Public Register under the Tax Agent Services Act 2009?
prompts.why_it_matters: Charging fees for preparing or lodging Australian income tax returns or providing tax advice without an active TPB registration is a criminal offense under the Tax Agent Services Act 2009.
prompts.how_to_query: Query the TPB Public Register by registered tax agent name {company}, partner name, or registration number
prompts.found_when: The firm or individual prepares fee-based tax lodgments but is not registered on the TPB register
prompts.not_found_when: The tax agent registration is verified active and current with no restrictive conditions
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The TPB register portal is undergoing scheduled maintenance or access challenge

tested.result: Active registered tax agent status verified on TPB public register
Holds current registered tax agent credentials under TPB records
Registered tax agent practice verified with active standing
Re-tested round 2: verified active register criteria for Tax Practitioners Board (TPB Public Register)

prompts.question: Has the tax agent or accounting practice been subject to formal sanctions, suspension, termination, or board orders by the Tax Practitioners Board?
prompts.why_it_matters: Sanctioned tax practitioners on the TPB register represent extreme risk for business clients, potentially triggering Australian Taxation Office (ATO) audits and revoked tax agent portal access.
prompts.how_to_query: Search TPB Board Conduct Committee (BCC) published decisions and public register disciplinary notations for {company}
prompts.found_when: The agent's register record displays formal sanction orders, suspension, or termination under the Code of Professional Conduct
prompts.not_found_when: The practitioner has zero disciplinary notations, orders, or sanctions recorded on the TPB register
prompts.couldnt_check_when: TPB public register server is temporarily unreachable

tested.result: No disciplinary orders or sanctions recorded on TPB register
Clean regulatory history with zero adverse board orders
No sanctions or disciplinary terminations found
Re-tested round 2: verified active register criteria for Tax Practitioners Board (BCC Sanctions & Orders)

prompts.question: Does the firm claim to provide statutory company audits without holding an active ASIC Registered Company Auditor (RCA) license under the Corporations Act 2001?
prompts.why_it_matters: Signing statutory corporate audit reports without an ASIC Registered Company Auditor number violates the Corporations Act 2001 and invalidates the audited financial statements.
prompts.how_to_query: Search ASIC Professional Registers under 'Registered Company Auditor' for {person} or {company}
prompts.found_when: The firm issues or markets statutory company audit opinions without an active RCA registration
prompts.not_found_when: The lead audit partner holds an active ASIC Registered Company Auditor license number
prompts.couldnt_check_when: ASIC Professional Registers search system is offline

tested.result: Business advisory and SME tax focus without uncertified company audit claims
Forensic and business accounting services operate within certified scope
Auditing services backed by registered professional credentials
Re-tested round 2: verified active register criteria for Australian Securities and Investments Commission (ASIC)

prompts.question: Does the principal partner hold an active Certificate of Public Practice (CPP) with CA ANZ or CPA Australia matching public marketing claims?
prompts.why_it_matters: Advertising as Chartered Accountants or CPA practice without an active Certificate of Public Practice breaches professional institute rules and misleading conduct provisions of Australian Consumer Law.

source.name: Chartered Accountants Australia and New Zealand (CA ANZ)

prompts.how_to_query: Search CA ANZ 'Find a CA' or CPA Australia public directories for {person} or firm name
prompts.found_when: The firm brands itself as a Chartered Accounting or CPA practice but lacks an active Certificate of Public Practice
prompts.not_found_when: Firm principals are verified with active Certificates of Public Practice and compliant professional indemnity insurance
prompts.couldnt_check_when: Professional institute directory search service times out

tested.result: Principal partner holds verified Chartered Accountant credentials with CA ANZ
Senior accounting leadership maintains active Chartered Accounting public practice certificates
Public practice certificates confirmed active on professional body records
Re-tested round 2: verified active register criteria for Chartered Accountants Australia and New Zealand (CA ANZ)

prompts.question: Does the firm offer Self-Managed Superannuation Fund (SMSF) audits without holding an active ASIC SMSF Auditor registration number (SAN)?
prompts.why_it_matters: Under the Superannuation Industry (Supervision) Act 1993, only ASIC-registered SMSF auditors can sign off on SMSF annual returns; unaccredited audits render fund compliance void.
prompts.how_to_query: Query ASIC SMSF Auditor register with partner name or SMSF Auditor Number (SAN)
prompts.found_when: The practice conducts statutory SMSF audits but lacks a current ASIC SMSF Auditor registration
prompts.not_found_when: The auditor's SAN registration is active with zero ASIC disqualification notices
prompts.couldnt_check_when: ASIC SMSF auditor register search is unavailable

tested.result: SMSF administration complies with independent approved auditor requirements
Superannuation compliance workflows verified against ASIC statutory rules
SMSF audit division operates under verified registered auditor credentials
Re-tested round 2: verified active register criteria for ASIC SMSF Auditor Register
